newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Talisman Energy rated buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Talisman Energy rated buy.

text.p: -- CS First Boston analyst Tyler Dann said he initiated coverage of Talisman Energy Inc with a buy rating.
-- shares were up C$0.15 to C$40.70 on the Toronto Stock Exchange.
-- estimated earnings of C$0.88 per share for 1997 and C$0.70 for 1998, with the lower 1998 figure due to an expected decline in oil prices.

-- cited following positive factors: good track record of cash flow growth; good opportunities in exploration projects, especially in Algeria and Indonesia; high-quality management; and the stock price, which has fallen 20 percent from a high several weeks ago.
